title: 1362: Update asset attribute when saving force

comments_data.body: Hi @IanMayo , I refactored a bit our dialog, I create a new component called `CustomDialog` which allows us to easily display a modal and easily customize its style. I also updated the `Confirm` dialog to use `CustomDialog` internally. Now all dialogs will have consistent style. - Show an error when validate an asset failed - New confirm dialog (wrap Custom Dialog inside)

Hello @lebaphi - I've made some changes, but couldn't quite get things working.

If the attributes of a force asset don't match the platform-type, the Game Designer is unable to fix that with the current UI.

But, if they don't match - it's quite simple to fix any problems: we can remove extra attributes, and insert missing ones.   I've implemented the code to that.  It also puts a message up if changes had to be made. 

But, the UI doesn't update, we still see the previous (partially wrong) set of attributes - would you mind investigating what is going wrong please?

Note: I've been testing with `NORT` on force `blue-1`.

Thanks @lebaphi 

One change.  We have the `player can edit` flag.  We ignore that flag when we're in the Game Admin pages.  The Game Designer can change any attribute.  So - we can use the dialog, but we need to use a special flag when the editor is being used from the game admin pages.  Suggested the flag (prop) is called `userIsAdmin`.

I'm pretty sure we're still missing one feature @lebaphi :
- when we add a new asset, it should get the attributes from the parent `platform-type`, including the default values (when present), otherwise zero.

> I'm pretty sure we're still missing one feature @lebaphi :

@lebaphi - I fixed this, in this commit: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/1367/commits/8a08158f1db21e0c5308861cca3f7a10895f6670

issues.title: Two features missing in `attributes`
issues.body:
I've just realised we are missing two capabilities related to `attributes`. They are both in the admin pages.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/156004067-a3655fad-5dcc-45f2-9e76-67e9169893c9.png)


1. When adding a new `asset` to a `force`, lookup the `attributes` for that `platform-type` and add the relevant `attributes` to the new `asset`. An `asset` is added to a force by dragging one of the platform-type icons into the `List of assets` section.
2. Before allowing a `SAVE FORCE`, do a check that the `attributes` are correct for each asset. Specifically, do this:
    a. Find the platform-type for the asset
    b. Check that each attribute is present on the asset
    c. Check that no extra attributes are present on the asset
    d. Popup a warning if anything is wrong.  The dialog should include the asset name(s) and what the problem is.

comments.body:
Hi @IanMayo , I pushed a new PR for this issue 1, we can save force with the asset attributes. I just wonder about the issue 2.
How can the user can save force with extra asset attributes, I see we allow the user to edit the current attribute value, not to add more attribute 🤔

It's if the Game Designer changes the attributes for that `platform type` while still designing the game.  The may remove an attribute for `fishing vessel`, but he has already created some instances of `fishing vessel` - so we do some tidying up for him.
